"""WorkflowError branches of map_work_item_error and shared output models."""

from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from mem_mcp.mcp.errors import JsonRpcError
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools import _work_item_common as common
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import WorkItemOutput, map_work_item_error
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors import (
    MoveBlockedError,
    SignoffCompleteError,
    SignoffRequiredError,
)

\<email>(
    ("exc", "code"),
    [
        (MoveBlockedError("todo", "done", "no transition"), "move_blocked"),
        (SignoffRequiredError(uuid4()), "signoff_required"),
        (SignoffCompleteError(), "signoff_complete"),
    ],
)
def test_workflow_errors_map_to_invalid_params(exc: Exception, code: str) -> None:
    err = map_work_item_error(exc)
    assert isinstance(err, JsonRpcError)
    assert err.code == -32602
    assert err.data["code"] == code


def test_unmapped_exception_propagates_unchanged() -> None:
    exc = ValueError("boom")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as info:
        map_work_item_error(exc)
    assert info.value is exc


def test_output_models_shape() -> None:
    assert issubclass(common.WorkItemWithMovesOutput, WorkItemOutput)
    fields = common.WorkItemWithMovesOutput.model_fields
    for name in ("current_stage", "allowed_moves", "blocked_reason", "pending_signoff"):
        assert name in fields
    assert "awaiting_signoff" in common.ProposeMoveOutput.model_fields
    assert common.RemapWorkflowOutput(updated_count=2).updated_count == 2
EOF
